material_type.evidence: inferred: 15 5µm thick tissue sections from FFPE biopsy blocks were deparaffinized and resuspended in ammonium bicarbonate with Protease Max.

sample_source.evidence: In this study, differences in global protein expression of small intestinal biopsy specimens from CD patients were quantified by analyzing formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded material using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry and label-free protein quantitation.
